The Method

The 90-Day Program — Outline

90 Days · 15 Courses · 105 Lessons

Build a business that runs without you. Then go live the life it pays for.

Ninety days, one course a week, with me on the call every week. For anyone building an online business — creatives, agency owners, and every kind of service business, from the first client to the day it runs without you.

I. Overview

Build the business. Build yourself. This is the exact process I've used to build my own companies and to train the people who now run them. It isn't theory. It's what I did, written down in order, so you can do it too.

My process is simple: you build the business, and you build yourself. Not two projects. One. — James Thomas

A finished business has a definition. You can leave it, sell it, or run it from your phone on the other side of the world — and it holds. Anything less is a job you own. Everything in these ninety days is built toward that finish line: time freedom, location freedom and financial freedom, designed in from day one instead of hoped for at the end.

What’s included

  • The weekly live call — Every week with me. Thirty minutes of teaching, thirty minutes of your questions. Every call is recorded.
  • The Classroom — Fifteen courses over twelve weeks, in the order I'd teach you one-on-one — plus tracks for your industry.
  • The Vault — The guides, templates, scripts and systems we actually run our own agency on.
  • The community — People building the same thing, at every stage. Post your numbers. Ask real questions.

II. The Five Stages

Everyone runs all ninety days, in order. Your stage tells you where to push hardest. Most people are one stage behind where they think they are. That's normal, and it's the fastest way through.

StageNameWhat it looks likePush hardest
0Starting from zeroNo business yet. You want an online business and the freedom that comes with it.Course 02
1Doing it allFreelancer or solo operator. You find the work, do the work, chase the invoice. Feast or famine.Courses 03–05
2It runs through youReal revenue, real clients — and every one of them needs you. Around $10–30K a month.Courses 06–09
3A team, not a machinePeople on payroll, but you're still the bottleneck. Around $30–100K a month.Courses 09–12
4Owner, not operatorIt runs without you. Now it's about scale, deals, and the life it pays for.Courses 13–14

III. The 90-Day Program — Three Moves

The program is ninety days: one move a month, one course a week, one live call a week. It's the same path I walked my brother through — from someone who just wanted to have a company, to running one fully remote at six figures a month.

  1. Money In Days 1–30 · Weeks 1–4
    An offer people understand, a steady flow of leads, and you selling it with confidence. Cash coming in every week.
  2. The Machine Days 31–60 · Weeks 5–8
    Someone else delivers. Systems, SOPs, a CRM, your first hires. Clients stay, and the work moves without you touching it.
  3. Step Out Days 61–90 · Weeks 9–12
    The numbers run on a scoreboard, the team runs the day, and you run the company from your phone — anywhere.

Rich · Fit · Sick runs underneath all ninety days. Rich — the work, the learning, a rich life. Fit — train every day. Sick — mindset, reading, style, the standard you hold. The business and the person get built at the same time.

VIII. How It Runs

The weekly rhythm

  • Monday — Post your target for the week and the one number you're moving.
  • The live call — Thirty minutes of teaching, thirty minutes of your questions. Recorded into the Classroom.
  • Friday — Post your wins and your misses. Both count.

The rules of the room

  1. Show your work. Wins, misses, work in progress. This room runs on real reps.
  2. Ask specific questions. “How do I get clients?” gets less than “Here's my offer, my market, and what's broken.”
  3. What's shared here stays here. Members' numbers and businesses are private.
  4. No pitching. Help people. If you've helped someone, a DM is fine.
  5. Do the assignments. Every course ends with one. That's where the results are.

IX. Where You Start — Start withCourse 00.

You don't need to know everything to begin. You need to know your stage, your target, and the next step. The rest comes one course at a time, one week at a time, with me on the call every week.

  1. Watch Course 00 — it takes less than an hour.
  2. Post your stage, your target and your date in the community.
  3. Show up to the next live call with one real question.

— James
